buildings:dairy:newmedievalcreameryc.desc: An upgraded Medieval Creamery with improved efficiency.

buildings:dairy:newmedievalcreameryd.desc: An upgraded Medieval Creamery with improved efficiency.

buildings:dairy:newmedievalcreamerye.desc: An upgraded Medieval Creamery with improved efficiency.

buildings:dairy:nmt30creamery.name: Old Creamery
where: Food Processing → Dairies → Old Creamery
RK Toolbar → RK Food → Old Creamery
buildings:dairy:nmt30creamery.desc: An Old Creamery processes milk into dairy products.

buildings:dairy:olddairy.name: Old Dairy
where: Dairies → Old Dairy
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Themed Sets → Old Buildings → Old Dairy
Hospitals → Old Dairy
buildings:dairy:olddairy.desc: A Colonial dairy where a dairyman processes milk into cheese, cream, or butter.

buildings:dairy:redcreamery.name: Red Creamery
where: Dairies → Red Creamery
RK Toolbar → RK Food → Red Creamery
buildings:dairy:redcreamery.desc: Red Creamery dairy building; processes milk into cheese, cream, butter, and yogurt.

buildings:dairy:redcreamerymain.name: Red Creamery (Main)
where: Dairies → Red Creamery (Main)
RK Toolbar → RK Food → Red Creamery (Main)
buildings:dairy:redcreamerymain.desc: Red Creamery main dairy building; processes milk into cheese, cream, butter, and yogurt.

buildings:dairy:rkredcreamery.name: Red Creamery
where: Food Processing → Dairies → Red Creamery
RK Toolbar → RK Food → Red Creamery
buildings:dairy:rkredcreamery.desc: The Red Creamery is a large RK Editor Choice dairy building where a Dairyman processes Milk into Cheese, Cream, Butter, and fruit Yogurts.

buildings:dairy:shcow.name: SH Cow
where: Themed Sets → Summer Haven → SH Cow
KID Mods → Themed Mods → Summer Haven → SH Cow
Food Production → Animal Sheds and Pens → SH Cow
buildings:dairy:shcow.desc: Summer Haven cow pasture. Produces milk with no input materials required.

buildings:dairy:shwdairyman.name: Dairyman
where: Themed Sets → Summer Haven → Workplace → Dairyman
Community Toolbar → KID Toolbar → Themed Mods. → Summer Haven → Workplace → Dairyman
Dairies → Dairyman
buildings:dairy:shwdairyman.desc: A dairyman makes different products from milk.

buildings:dairy:tinydairy.name: Tiny Dairy
where: KID Toolbar → Food Production → Tiny Dairy
Food Processing → Dairies → Tiny Dairy
buildings:dairy:tinydairy.desc: The Tiny Dairy is a compact dairy from the KID Toolbar where Dairymen process Milk into cheese, cream, butter, and yogurt.

buildings:dairy:vccheese.name: VC Cheese
where: KID Mods → Resource Production → VC Cheese
Food Production → Animal Sheds and Pens → VC Cheese
buildings:dairy:vccheese.desc: A cheese-making building from the Animal Shed Cheese mod. Produces Goat Cheese on its own, or Herb Cheese when supplied with Herbs.

buildings:dairy:wpdairyman.name: WP Dairyman
where: KID Mods → Resource Production → WorkPlace → WP Dairyman
Food Processing → Dairies → WP Dairyman
buildings:dairy:wpdairyman.desc: KID WorkPlace dairy; processes milk into cheese, cream, and butter, and makes fruit yogurt from milk combined with blueberry, peach, or cherry.

buildings:decorations:a8prideflags.name: Pride Flags
where: Decorative → Statues, Flags and Monuments → Pride Flags
buildings:decorations:a8prideflags.desc: Some brightly colored flags to celebrate Pride, from the A8 mod set. Free to place, with a remove tool; holds nothing. 28 flag designs are available, cycled through in-game.

buildings:decorations:bamboolatticefence.name: Bamboo Lattice Fence
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → A8 Walls → Bamboo Lattice Fence
buildings:decorations:bamboolatticefence.desc: A decorative woven bamboo lattice fence from the A8 Japanese mod, for enclosing gardens in a traditional Japanese style.

buildings:decorations:brandenburgertor.name: Brandenburger Tor
where: Decorative → Brandenburger Tor
buildings:decorations:brandenburgertor.desc: The Brandenburg Gate (Brandenburger Tor) — a colossal monumental landmark from the EB (embx61) mod. At 30×16 tiles and 25,000 work, it is a true end-game showpiece requiring a vast quantity of materials.

buildings:decorations:brickcitysidewalk.name: Brick City Sidewalk
where: Decorative → Brick City Sidewalk
buildings:decorations:brickcitysidewalk.desc: An Angainor88 American City Living decorative brick sidewalk piece. Free to place, with a remove tool.

buildings:decorations:brimmerhouseplants.name: City Planters
where: Decorative → City Planters
buildings:decorations:brimmerhouseplants.desc: An Angainor88 American City Living decorative plant box. Free to place, with a remove tool.

buildings:decorations:crystalgoat.name: Decorative Goat
where: Decorative → Animals → Decorative Goat
buildings:decorations:crystalgoat.desc: A decorative goat from Necora's Maritimes Crystal Cliffs. Has no footprint and can be placed freely; it also provides a small Safety happiness boost within a 20-tile radius.

buildings:decorations:deadwood.name: Deadwood
where: Decorative → Plants → Deadwood → the deadwood piece
buildings:decorations:deadwood.desc: Decorative dead trees and logs from Kid's Deadwood mod, for dressing up wilderness, swamps and abandoned scenery. Free to place.

buildings:decorations:decomagicmushroom.name: Deco Magic Mushroom
where: Decorative → Plants → Deco Magic Mushroom → the mushroom
buildings:decorations:decomagicmushroom.desc: Decorative magic mushrooms from Kid's Deco Magic Mushroom mod, in a range of sizes — a whimsical accent for fairy gardens and forest scenes. Free to place.

buildings:decorations:decopeople.name: Deco People
where: Decorative → Deco People → the figure
buildings:decorations:decopeople.desc: Decorative human figures from Kid's Deco People mod — ghosted, free-placing statues of villagers used to bring streets, markets and yards to life. They have no footprint and overlap freely, and come in several outfit sets.

buildings:decorations:decosakebarrel.name: Sake Barrel
where: Decorative → Crates → Sake Barrel
buildings:decorations:decosakebarrel.desc: A decorative stack of sake barrels (kazaridaru) from the A8 Japanese mod. Has no footprint and can be placed freely.

buildings:decorations:decowreaths.name: Decoration Wreaths
where: Decorative → Decoration Wreaths → the wreath
buildings:decorations:decowreaths.desc: Decorative wreaths from Kid's Deco Wreaths mod, to hang on walls and over doors. Free to place, in a range of floral designs.

buildings:decorations:deerscare.name: Deerscare
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → Deerscare
buildings:decorations:deerscare.desc: A decorative bamboo deer-scarer (shishi-odoshi) from the A8 Japanese mod — a water-fed rocking bamboo fountain. A small 1×1 garden ornament.

buildings:decorations:dscelticpalisade.name: Celtic Palisade
where: Decorative → Fences → Celtic Palisade
DS mods → DS Celtic House → Celtic Palisade
buildings:decorations:dscelticpalisade.desc: A set of DS Celtic House defensive timber palisade pieces. Combine straight, corner, open, gate, and tower pieces to fortify a settlement. Available in two heights — low (05) and high (10).

buildings:decorations:dscelticstonelugh.name: Lugh's Stone
where: More Town Buildings → Lugh's Stone
DS mods → DS Celtic House → Lugh's Stone
buildings:decorations:dscelticstonelugh.desc: A DS Celtic House monumental standing stone — a decorative 6×6 landmark dedicated to the god Lugh, raised at the unusual cost of 200 Venison.

buildings:decorations:dschristmasdeco.name: Christmas Decorations
where: Themed → Christmas Mod → select decoration
buildings:decorations:dschristmasdeco.desc: Festive decorations from the Christmas Mod — a snowman and three wreath designs to dress the colony for the holidays.

buildings:decorations:dsghoststrongalepi.name: Deco Strong Ale Barrels
where: Decorative → Crates, Barrels, Piles → Deco Strong Ale Barrels
buildings:decorations:dsghoststrongalepi.desc: A decorative pile of strong ale barrels from the DS Ale House mod. Has no footprint and can be placed freely to dress taverns and storage yards.

buildings:decorations:dsjabboats.name: DS Small Boats
where: DS mods → Fences, Walls & Deco → Jetty Deco → select boat
buildings:decorations:dsjabboats.desc: Decorative small boats from the DS Jetty & Bridge mod, placed on water to dress harbours and jetties. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely.

buildings:decorations:dsjabjettydeco.name: DS Jetty Decorations
where: Life on the Water → DS Jetty Deco → select decoration
buildings:decorations:dsjabjettydeco.desc: A set of DS Jetty & Bridge decorative accents for dressing jetties and waterfronts — benches, poles, fence rails, stairs, and low deck pieces. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely.

buildings:decorations:dsjabjettyplatform.name: DS Jetty Platforms
where: Life on the Water → DS Jetty & Bridge → Texture #1 / #2 → Jetty pieces
buildings:decorations:dsjabjettyplatform.desc: A set of DS Jetty & Bridge walkable jetty deck pieces, used to build piers and platforms over water. Combine the 1×1, 2×1, and 3×1 sections, corners, high/low decks, angles, and stairs. Every piece comes in two texture styles (T1 light-brown and T2 blue-grey).

buildings:decorations:dslumbermilldeco.name: Lumber Mill Decorations
where: Decorative → Crates → Lumber Mill Decorations
DS mods → DS Lumber Mill → Lumber Mill Decorations
buildings:decorations:dslumbermilldeco.desc: A set of DS Lumber Mill decorative pieces — log piles, lumber stacks, and wharf platforms — for dressing a sawmill yard. Includes free decorative log/lumber piles and built wharf pieces.

buildings:decorations:dssvflags.name: Village Flags
where: Decorative → Statues → Village Flags
buildings:decorations:dssvflags.desc: Decorative DS Small Village flags. Raise a flag pole, then fly pennant or burgee flags from it to dress the village.

buildings:decorations:ebdecofence.name: EB Decorative Fence
where: Decorative → Fences → EB Decorative Fences
buildings:decorations:ebdecofence.desc: A large set of decorative EB (embx61) wooden fence pieces, available in four wood finishes — Cherry, Oak, Wenge, and White. Each finish includes straight, corner, end, gate, 3-way, and 4-way pieces, plus capped (C) and ghosted sub-variants, for building fully connected fences around gardens and prop

buildings:decorations:ebdecostatues.name: EB Decorative Statues
where: Decorative → Statues → select statue
buildings:decorations:ebdecostatues.desc: A set of classical Greco-Roman statue decorations from the EB (embx61) mod. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely and overlapping other objects.

buildings:decorations:eboutdoorfurniture.name: EB Outdoor Furniture
where: Decorative → select Beach Deco or Resort Deco furniture
buildings:decorations:eboutdoorfurniture.desc: A set of decorative outdoor furniture from the EB (embx61) Beach Deco and Resort Deco mods, for dressing beaches, parks, and resorts. Each piece has no footprint and can be placed freely and overlapping other objects.

buildings:decorations:ebships.name: EB Decorative Ships
where: Decorative → Boats → select ship
buildings:decorations:ebships.desc: Decorative sailing ships from the EB (embx61) mods, placed on water to dress harbours and rivers. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely.

buildings:decorations:ebstatuesofhonour.name: EB Statues of Honour
where: Decorative → Statues → select statue
buildings:decorations:ebstatuesofhonour.desc: Monumental memorial statues from the EB (embx61) Statues of Honour mod. Each comes as a standard built statue, a free "Ghosted" no-footprint version, and a "Nomad" version that attracts wandering nomads to the colony.

buildings:decorations:ebstatuetrapper.name: Statue of Trapper Luke
where: Decorative → Statues → Statue of Trapper Luke
buildings:decorations:ebstatuetrapper.desc: A commemorative statue of Trapper Luke from the EB (embx61) mod. A free "Ghosted" no-footprint version is also available for overlapping placement.

buildings:decorations:ebstonewall.name: EB Stone Wall
where: Decorative → Fences → EB Stone Walls
buildings:decorations:ebstonewall.desc: A set of decorative EB (embx61) stone wall pieces. Combine the straight, corner, gate, and post pieces to enclose properties. Each piece comes in standard and free "Ghosted" (no-footprint, overlapping) versions, with A/B style sub-variants.

buildings:decorations:ebsvanimalshelter.name: Village Animal Shelter
where: Decorative → Village Animal Shelter
buildings:decorations:ebsvanimalshelter.desc: A decorative animal shelter from the EB Simple Village (embx61) mod — a model-only farmyard ornament with no working function. Available with or without surrounding fencing (the "No Fence" variant).

buildings:decorations:ebsvdecostatues.name: EB Village Statues
where: Decorative → Statues → select statue
buildings:decorations:ebsvdecostatues.desc: A set of decorative statues from the EB Simple Village (embx61) mod. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely and overlapping other objects.

buildings:decorations:ebsvsigns.name: EB Village Signs
where: Decorative → EB Signs
buildings:decorations:ebsvsigns.desc: A set of decorative EB Simple Village (embx61) signposts — town, market, top, and bottom signs in yellow and white finishes. Each has no footprint and uses ghosted placement, with multiple F-key appearance variants.

buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntrader.name: Trader Sign Yellow
where: Decorative → EB Signs → Trader Sign Yellow
Community Toolbar → EB Toolbar → EB Decorations → EB Signs → Trader Sign Yellow
buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntrader.desc: An EB Simple Village decorative yellow trader sign. Ghosted placement; intended for decoration near Trading Ports. Eight F Key visual variants.

buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderdoub.name: Trader Sign Double Yellow
where: Decorative → EB Signs → Trader Sign Double Yellow
Community Toolbar → EB Toolbar → EB Decorations → EB Signs → Trader Sign Double Yellow
buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderdoub.desc: An EB Simple Village decorative double yellow trader sign. Ghosted placement; intended for decoration near Trading Ports. Six F Key visual variants.

buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderdoub.name: Trader Sign Double White
where: Decorative → EB Signs → Trader Sign Double White
Community Toolbar → EB Toolbar → EB Decorations → EB Signs → Trader Sign Double White
buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderdoub.desc: An EB Simple Village decorative double white trader sign. Ghosted placement; intended for decoration near Trading Ports. Six F Key visual variants.

buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderw.name: Trader Sign White
where: Decorative → EB Signs → Trader Sign White
Community Toolbar → EB Toolbar → EB Decorations → EB Signs → Trader Sign White
buildings:decorations:ebsvsigntraderw.desc: An EB Simple Village decorative white trader sign. Ghosted placement; intended for decoration near Trading Ports. Eight F Key visual variants.

buildings:decorations:ebvillagefence.name: EB Village Fence
where: Decorative → Fences → select EB Village fence piece
buildings:decorations:ebvillagefence.desc: Decorative wooden fencing from the EB Simple Village (embx61) mod. Combine the straight, corner, end, and gate pieces to fence off areas. Comes in a standard Wood Fence set and a Fence-Less (ghosted, overlapping-placement) set, plus a matching End Railing edge piece.

buildings:decorations:elfgirl.name: Elf Girl
where: Decorative → Elf Girl → the statue or wall
buildings:decorations:elfgirl.desc: A set of decorative statues and matching walls from Kid's Elf Girl mod — a whimsical garden ornament set. Free to place.

buildings:decorations:essaouiraboatdeco.name: Essaouira Boat Deco
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → Essaouira Boat Deco
Decorative → Boats → Essaouira Boat Deco
buildings:decorations:essaouiraboatdeco.desc: A decorative fishing boat from the A8 Moroccan Misc mod, placed on water as a visual decoration. Four appearance variants are available. Can be removed via the Remove Item button.

buildings:decorations:fbhusky.name: Husky
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Friendly Blue → Friendly Deco → Husky
Themed Sets → Friendly Blue → Friendly Deco → Husky
buildings:decorations:fbhusky.desc: The Husky is a free decorative object from the Friendly Blue mod. It places a ghosted husky dog in the colony. It can be removed via its dialog.

buildings:decorations:fbhuskyhouse.name: Husky House
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Friendly Blue → Friendly Deco → Husky House
Themed Sets → Friendly Blue → Friendly Deco → Husky House
Housing → KID Homes and Housing → Friendly Blue → Husky House
buildings:decorations:fbhuskyhouse.desc: The Husky House is a free decorative object from the Friendly Blue mod. It places a small dog kennel in the colony. It can be removed via its dialog.

buildings:decorations:festivalground.name: Festival Ground
where: Decorative → Parks and Rec → Festival Ground → the tent or decoration
buildings:decorations:festivalground.desc: Kid's Festival Ground — a set of fairground tents and decorations to build a festival site. The tents double as happiness sources, each covering a different need.

buildings:decorations:ghostflowers.name: Ghost Flowers
where: Decorative → Ghost Flowers → the flower-bed piece
buildings:decorations:ghostflowers.desc: A decorative flower-bed tiling system from Kid's Ghost Flowers mod — coloured flowers laid as tile pieces (center, corner, edge and row sections) so a flower bed of any shape can be filled in. Purely cosmetic and free to place, in a normal and a "High" (taller) style.

buildings:decorations:iseefire.name: I See Fire — Torches & Candles
where: Decorative → I See Fire → Real Wall Torch (for the wall-torch positions) or the torch / candle piece
buildings:decorations:iseefire.desc: The decorative lighting pieces from RedKetchup's I See Fire mod — free-standing and wall-mounted torches plus candles, used to light streets, walls and courtyards at night. They are free to place. (The mod's larger fire features — Real Huge Bonfire, Real Bonfire, Real Firecamp and Real Firepot — are

buildings:decorations:japandecojars.name: Deco Jars
where: Decorative → Deco Jars
buildings:decorations:japandecojars.desc: A decorative cluster of Japanese ceramic jars from the A8 Japanese mod. Has no footprint and can be placed freely.

buildings:decorations:japanesecemeterywa.name: Japanese Cemetery Wall
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → A8 Walls → Japanese Cemetery Wall
buildings:decorations:japanesecemeterywa.desc: A set of decorative Japanese cemetery wall and gate pieces from the A8 Japanese mod, used to enclose graveyards and shrines. Combine the straight, corner, end, junction, and gate pieces to build an enclosure. Decorative only — no burial function.

buildings:decorations:japanesefence.name: Japanese Fence
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → A8 Walls → Japanese Fence
buildings:decorations:japanesefence.desc: Decorative Japanese wooden fence pieces from the A8 Japanese mod, used to enclose gardens and properties. Combine the straight, corner, end, and gate pieces to build a continuous fence.

buildings:decorations:japaneseplantdecor.name: Japanese Plant Decorations
where: Decorative → Plants → select plant
buildings:decorations:japaneseplantdecor.desc: A set of decorative Japanese trees, shrubs, and plants from the A8 Japanese mod. Each has no footprint, so it can be placed freely and overlapping other objects to landscape Japanese-style settlements.

buildings:decorations:jinxiebittyroundta.name: Bitty Round Table
where: Decorative → Parks and Rec → Bitty Round Table
buildings:decorations:jinxiebittyroundta.desc: A decorative round picnic table from Jinxie's Bitty Pasta mod. Has no footprint and can be placed freely, with 3 F-key appearance variants.

buildings:decorations:jinxiechickencoopd.name: Jinxie Chicken Coop Decorations
where: Decorative → Animals → Jinxie's Bitty Chicken Coop Set → select decoration
buildings:decorations:jinxiechickencoopd.desc: A set of decorative poultry from Jinxie's Bitty Chicken Coop Set, for dressing farmyards. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely, with many F-key appearance variants.

buildings:decorations:jinxiefestivalpark.name: Jinxie Festival Parks
where: Decorative → Parks and Rec → Jinxie's Festival Park Set → select park
buildings:decorations:jinxiefestivalpark.desc: A set of decorated festival parks from Jinxie's Festival Park Set. Each is a free 5×5 plot that provides Entertainment happiness to citizens within a 20-tile radius, with 3 F-key variations for wood colour.

buildings:decorations:jinxienaturaldecor.name: Jinxie Natural Decorations
where: Decorative → Decorative Trees and Plants → Jinxie's Natural Deco Set → select item
buildings:decorations:jinxienaturaldecor.desc: A set of decorative base-game natural elements from Jinxie's Natural Deco Set — trees, rocks, ore, crops, and gathering props placed purely for looks. Each has no footprint and can be placed freely and overlapping other objects, with F-key appearance options.

buildings:decorations:jriverquays.name: River Quay Wall
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 deco → River Quay Wall
buildings:decorations:jriverquays.desc: Decorative stone river-quay wall pieces from the A8 Japanese mod, used to build embankments along waterways. Available in large, small, and diagonal pieces.

buildings:decorations:kiddecocrates.name: Decorative Crates (Kid)
where: Decorative → Decorative Crates → the crate cluster
buildings:decorations:kiddecocrates.desc: Kid's Deco Crates — purely decorative crates, barrels and sacks for dressing up markets, docks and storehouses. Free to place, with a remove tool; they hold nothing.

buildings:decorations:kiddecoplants.name: Exotic Plants
where: Decorative → Plants → Exotic Plants → the plant
buildings:decorations:kiddecoplants.desc: A large set of decorative exotic plants from Kid's Deco Plants mod, for greening gardens, courtyards and greenhouses. All are purely cosmetic and free to place.

buildings:decorations:kidoldfence.name: Old Fence (Kid)
where: Decorative → Fences → Old Fence
buildings:decorations:kidoldfence.desc: Kid's Old Fence — a simple weathered decorative fence for edging fields, yards and paths. Free to place, with a remove tool.

buildings:decorations:kidsomeboats.name: Some Boats
where: Decorative → Some Boats → the boat
buildings:decorations:kidsomeboats.desc: Kid's Some Boats — a set of ghosted, free decorative boats to moor along shores and docks. (The individual Fishing Boat and Fishing Boat 2 from this set have their own pages.)

buildings:decorations:kidworkshop.name: Kid Workshop
where: Main Toolbar (MT) — the pieces are sorted into the standard Decorations categories:

* Decorative → Deco Objects, Dung Pile, Hay Pile, Groundcover, Happy Squares * Food Production → Homestead → Farmyard 01, Farmyard 02 * Plants → Bush * Covers → 5×5 Cover, Awning Covers * Road Deco → Block Path, Gravel Path * Park → Playground
Community Toolbar (CT) — the modder's original location:
KID Toolbar → Misc → Kid Workshop → the piece (or its pop-out group)
buildings:decorations:kidworkshop.desc: A large set of decorative farmyard, garden, playground and street pieces from Kid's Workshop mod. Almost everything is purely cosmetic and free to place; the Happy Square pieces additionally emit a small happiness boost within a 16-tile radius. Pieces are grouped into several pop-out toolbars. Two p

buildings:decorations:koipond.name: Koi Pond
where: Decorative → Parks and Rec → Koi Pond
buildings:decorations:koipond.desc: A landscaped koi pond from the A8 Japanese mod. It provides Spirit happiness to nearby citizens within a 30-tile radius.

buildings:decorations:maritimescoverings.name: Maritimes Coverings
where: Decorative → Covers → select covering
buildings:decorations:maritimescoverings.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes decorative roof coverings and awnings, used to span gaps between buildings and dress streets. Includes flat (1x/2x) and high/arched pieces with in/out/left/right/corner/end variants, each in Brown and Gray finishes. All are free with no footprint.

buildings:decorations:maritimescrystalfe.name: Crystal Cliffs Fence
where: Decorative → Fences → Crystal Cliffs Fence
buildings:decorations:maritimescrystalfe.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes Crystal Cliffs decorative fence pieces, available in Brown, Red, and White finishes. Combine the straight (1x1/1x2/1x3), diagonal, and gate pieces to enclose properties.

buildings:decorations:maritimesdecoratio.name: Maritimes Decorations
where: Decorative → Plants (trees), or Decorative → road/resource deco menus
buildings:decorations:maritimesdecoratio.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes decorative natural elements for landscaping — decorative trees, natural-resource props, and road accents. All are free with no footprint.

buildings:decorations:maritimesdockset.name: Maritimes Dock Set
where: Life on the Water → Maritimes Dock → select piece
buildings:decorations:maritimesdockset.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes walkable dock/jetty pieces for building piers over water. Combine the 1×1, 1×2, and 1×3 sections, corners, T-pieces, and stairs, in both standard and lower (middle) heights. Includes a decorative Lobster Pot.

buildings:decorations:maritimesfortanne.name: Fort Anne Earthworks
where: Decorative → Fences → Fort Anne Earthworks
buildings:decorations:maritimesfortanne.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes Fort Anne earthwork rampart pieces, used to build star-fort style earthen defences. Combine straight sections, diagonals, gates, orthogonal pieces, and inner/outer/left/right corners.

buildings:decorations:maritimesportroyal.name: Port Royal Fortifications
where: Decorative → Port Royal Fort → select piece
buildings:decorations:maritimesportroyal.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes Port Royal decorative fortification pieces, used to build a colonial fort. Combine palisade walls and corners, gates and gatehouses, towers, and mounted cannons.

buildings:decorations:maritimesriffle.name: Maritimes Riffle & Terrain Painting
where: Life on the Water → Maritimes Riffle / Painting → select tool
buildings:decorations:maritimesriffle.desc: A set of Necora Maritimes terrain-painting and water-feature tools. Use the Riffle pieces to add streams and waterfalls to rivers, and the Painting tools to flatten, dig, slope, and texture riverbeds and banks (driftwood, pebbles, edges) at several depths (0 / 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.75 m).

buildings:decorations:mcdeco.name: Deco Cave
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → More Caves Gray → Deco Cave
KID Mods → Themed Mods → More Caves Brown → Deco Cave
Themed Sets → More Caves Gray → Deco Cave
Themed Sets → More Caves Brown → Deco Cave
buildings:decorations:mcdeco.desc: A More Caves decorative rock cluster — purely decorative, free to place, with a dedicated remove tool. Available in two rock finishes, Gray and Brown, which are purely cosmetic.

buildings:decorations:mcdog.name: Dog Cave
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → More Caves Gray → Dog Cave
KID Mods → Themed Mods → More Caves Brown → Dog Cave
Themed Sets → More Caves Gray → Dog Cave
Themed Sets → More Caves Brown → Dog Cave
buildings:decorations:mcdog.desc: A More Caves decoration — a dog resting outside a cave den. Purely decorative, free to place, with a dedicated remove tool. Available in two rock finishes, Gray and Brown, which are purely cosmetic.

buildings:decorations:moroccanarch.name: Moroccan Arch

buildings:mining:allminingironmine.name: Multi-Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Multi-Mine
Community Toolbar → Additional Modders Toolbar → Resource → Multi-Mine
buildings:mining:allminingironmine.desc: The Multi-Mine is a large All-Mining building that extracts stone, iron ore, and coal all from a single massive mine.

buildings:mining:allminingquarry.name: Multi-Quarry
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Multi-Quarry
Additional Modders Toolbar → Resource → Multi-Quarry
buildings:mining:allminingquarry.desc: Used to mine iron, coal, and stone from the ground at the same time. This Quarry can be removed.

buildings:mining:apclosedmine.name: Closed Mine
where: KID Mods → Resource Production → Abandoned Resource → Closed Mine
Resource Production → Resource Production → Abandoned Resource → Closed Mine
buildings:mining:apclosedmine.desc: The Closed Mine is a placeable Abandoned Places decoration that serves as the starting point for the AP mine upgrade chain. It has no function of its own but can be upgraded to an Old Mine or directly to a New Mine.

buildings:mining:apnewmine.name: New Mine
where: KID Mods → Resource Production → Abandoned Resource → New Mine
Resource Production → Resource Production → Abandoned Resource → New Mine
The New Mine can also be reached by upgrading an existing Old Mine or Closed Mine.
buildings:mining:apnewmine.desc: The New Mine is an Abandoned Places building that gives miners a choice of Iron, Coal, or Gold depending on the local terrain.

buildings:mining:apoldmine.name: Old Mine
where: The Old Mine is not built directly from the toolbar. It is created by upgrading an existing Closed Mine.
buildings:mining:apoldmine.desc: The Old Mine is an Abandoned Places building that produces Stone and occasional Gold. It can be upgraded to a New Mine for more material options.

buildings:mining:blmquarry.name: Stone & Salt Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Stone & Salt Mine
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Stone & Salt Mine
buildings:mining:blmquarry.desc: A Surface Mine for mining Stone and Salt. Upgraded versions allow the ground to be reclaimed on removal. Stonecutters work here, not miners.

buildings:mining:blmquarry2.name: Iron Ore & Coal Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Iron Ore & Coal Mine
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Iron Ore & Coal Mine
buildings:mining:blmquarry2.desc: A Surface Mine for mining Iron Ore & Coal. Upgraded versions allow the ground to be reclaimed on removal. Stonecutters work here, not miners.

buildings:mining:blmquarry2deep.name: Deep Iron Ore & Coal Mine
where: Upgrade from the Iron Ore & Coal Mine.
buildings:mining:blmquarry2deep.desc: A Deep Surface Mine for mining Iron Ore & Coal. Provides much greater resource production.

buildings:mining:blmquarry2deeper.name: Deeper Iron Ore & Coal Mine
where: Upgrade from the Deep Iron Ore & Coal Mine.
buildings:mining:blmquarry2deeper.desc: A Deeper Surface Mine for mining Iron Ore & Coal. Provides vast amounts of resource production.

buildings:mining:blmquarrydeep.name: Deep Stone & Salt Mine
where: Upgrade from the Stone & Salt Mine.
buildings:mining:blmquarrydeep.desc: A Deep Surface Mine for mining Stone and Salt. Provides much greater resource production. Upgraded versions allow the ground to be reclaimed on removal.

buildings:mining:blmquarrydeeper.name: Deeper Stone & Salt Mine
where: Upgrade from the Deep Stone & Salt Mine.
buildings:mining:blmquarrydeeper.desc: A Deeper Surface Mine for mining Stone and Salt. Provides vast amounts of resource production. The ground can be reclaimed on removal.

buildings:mining:coalfurnace.name: Coal Furnace

buildings:mining:coppermine.name: Copper Ore Mine Shaft

Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Copper Ore Mine Shaft
buildings:mining:coppermine.desc: The Copper Ore Mine Shaft is a Colonial Charter mine that extracts copper ore from the ground. Miners can work it as an ore excavation or smelt copper directly using Furnace Fuel. The mine has a limited total yield of 350 units before it depletes, after which it can be upgraded to a Dark Copper Ore

buildings:mining:copperminedeep.name: Dark Copper Ore Mine Shaft
where: Upgrade from the Copper Ore Mine Shaft.
buildings:mining:copperminedeep.desc: A Dark Shaft Mine for mining Copper Ore. Provides much greater resource production.

buildings:mining:copperminedeeper.name: Deep Copper Ore Mine Shaft
where: Upgrade from the Dark Copper Ore Mine Shaft.
buildings:mining:copperminedeeper.desc: A Deeper Shaft Mine for mining Copper Ore. Provides vast amounts of resource production.

buildings:mining:dscoalbellpit1.name: Coal Bell Pit

Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Coal Bell Pit
buildings:mining:dscoalbellpit1.desc: Coal Bell Pit is a DS Mods mining building. Miners extract Coal from a limited underground seam. It has a maximum production of 600 before the seam is depleted, but can be upgraded to extend its lifespan. This building is a Detraction structure, reducing happiness for nearby citizens.

buildings:mining:dscoalbellpit1upgrade.name: Coal Bell Pit Mine
where: Upgrade from the Coal Bell Pit.
buildings:mining:dscoalbellpit1upgrade.desc: Upgrade to extend the Coal Bell Pit's lifespan and improve extraction speed, supporting up to 13 miners.

buildings:mining:dssmallironoremine.name: Small Iron Ore Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Small Iron Ore Mine
DS mods → Resource → Mining → Small Iron Ore Mine
buildings:mining:dssmallironoremine.desc: A small mountain mine that employs miners who will extract Iron Ore only. It has a limited production of 1200, but can be upgraded to continue operation.

buildings:mining:dssmallironoremine_upgr.name: Iron Ore Mine
where: Upgrade from the Small Iron Ore Mine.
buildings:mining:dssmallironoremine_upgr.desc: Upgrade to allow longer lifespan and slightly quicker extraction of Iron Ore, supporting up to 21 miners.

buildings:mining:dsthaddsurrelmine.name: Industry Mine
where: DS mods → Resource → Mining → Industry Mine
Also reachable via: Mines → Industry Mine
buildings:mining:dsthaddsurrelmine.desc: A massive DS Mods industrial mine — the Thadd Surrel & family operation — covering an 8 × 14 footprint and employing up to 55 Miners. Coal is the default product but the mine can be switched between Coal and Iron Ore. The pit imposes a Detraction happiness penalty in a 25-tile radius and depletes af

buildings:mining:dstunnelminecc.name: Tunnel Mine Random
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Tunnel Mine → Tunnel Mine Random
DS mods → Resource → Mining → Tunnel Mine → Tunnel Mine Random
buildings:mining:dstunnelminecc.desc: A Random Resource Production mine built into a mountain. Up to 8 Miners extract Stone, Coal and Iron Ore randomly. Can be upgraded to continue operation or converted to a mushroom farm.

buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccselect.name: Tunnel Mine Select
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Tunnel Mine → Tunnel Mine Select
DS mods → Resource → Mining → Tunnel Mine → Tunnel Mine Select
buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccselect.desc: A Select Resource Production mine built into a mountain. Up to 8 Miners extract Stone, Coal or Iron Ore via player selection. Can be upgraded to continue operation or converted to a mushroom farm.

buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccselectup.name: Tunnel Mine Upgrade
where: Upgrade from the Tunnel Mine Select.
buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccselectup.desc: Upgrade of the Tunnel Mine Select for significantly more resource production (40,000 limit) and up to 13 miners. The player continues to select which material to produce.

buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccup.name: Tunnel Mine Upgrade
where: Upgrade from the Tunnel Mine Random.
buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccup.desc: Upgrade of the Tunnel Mine Random for significantly more resource production (40,000 limit) and up to 13 miners. Production remains random among Iron Ore, Stone, and Coal.

buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccupmush.name: Old Mine Mushroom Farm
where: Upgrade from any Tunnel Mine variant: Tunnel Mine Random, Tunnel Mine Select, Tunnel Mine Upgrade (Random), or Tunnel Mine Upgrade (Select).
buildings:mining:dstunnelmineccupmush.desc: Converts a Tunnel Mine into a Mushroom Farm for all-weather production of mushrooms. 1–3 Farmers are employed to grow the mushrooms.

buildings:mining:ebsaltworks.name: Salt Works
where: Mines → Salt Works
EB Toolbar → EB Resources → Salt Works
buildings:mining:ebsaltworks.desc: A Discrepancy / EB-mod salt-evaporation works. Workers extract Salt for the colony's preservation and trade chains.

buildings:mining:ebsvironmine.name: Village Mine
where: Mines → Village Mine
EB Toolbar → EB Theme Toolbar → EB Village → Village Resource Production → Village Mines and Quarries → Village Mine
buildings:mining:ebsvironmine.desc: A Discrepancy / EB Small Village mine. Miners extract Iron Ore by default but the player can switch the operation between Iron Ore and Coal. The pit imposes a Detraction happiness penalty in a 30-tile radius and depletes after 2,000 units of total production.

buildings:mining:ebsvquarry.name: Village Quarry
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Village Quarry
EB Toolbar → EB Theme Toolbar → EB Village → Village Resources → Mines and Quarries → Village Quarry
buildings:mining:ebsvquarry.desc: The Village Quarry is used to gather stone. Up to 12 Stonecutters can be employed.

buildings:mining:ebsvrockquarry.name: Village Rock Quarry
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Village Rock Quarry
EB Toolbar → EB Theme Toolbar → EB Village → Village Resources → Mines and Quarries → Village Rock Quarry
buildings:mining:ebsvrockquarry.desc: The Village Rock Quarry is used to mine Stone. Up to 12 Stonecutters can be employed. The quarry can be transformed into a Fish Hatchery.

buildings:mining:ebsvrockquarryfish.name: Village Fish Hatchery
where: Upgrade from the Village Rock Quarry.
buildings:mining:ebsvrockquarryfish.desc: The Village Rock Quarry transformed into a Fish Hatchery. Up to 4 Fishermen can be employed to catch fish.

buildings:mining:ebsvsaltmine.name: Village Salt Mine
where: Mines → Village Salt Mine
EB Toolbar → EB Theme Toolbar → EB Village → Village Resource Production → Village Mines and Quarries → Village Salt Mine
buildings:mining:ebsvsaltmine.desc: A Discrepancy / EB Small Village salt mine. Miners dig Salt for the colony's preservation and trade.

buildings:mining:ecionmine.name: Mine (EC Edition)
where: RK Toolbar → RK transport → Mine (EC Edition)
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Mine (EC Edition)
buildings:mining:ecionmine.desc: The Mine (EC Edition) is the RK Editor's Choice iron mine. Miners choose to produce Iron Ore or Coal. When the mine nears depletion it can be upgraded through a series of renewal tiers to extend its life.

buildings:mining:ecironmine.name: Mine (EC Edition)
where: Mines → Mine (EC Edition)
RK Toolbar → RK transport → Mine (EC Edition)
buildings:mining:ecironmine.desc: The RK Editor's Choice mine — a massive 12 × 12 pit employing up to 30 Miners. Iron Ore is the default product but the mine can be switched between Iron Ore and Coal. The pit imposes a Detraction happiness penalty in a 30-tile radius and depletes after 8,000 units of total production.

buildings:mining:ecquarry.name: Quarry
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Quarry
RK Toolbar → RK transport → Quarry
buildings:mining:ecquarry.desc: A large quarry for mining Stone, supporting up to 30 Stonecutters. Part of the Editor's Choice Edition mod.

buildings:mining:exoticmine.name: Exotic Mine
buildings:mining:exoticmine.desc: A massive 12 × 12 mine with default crew of 10 Miners. Produces refined Iron directly from the seam. The pit imposes a Detraction happiness penalty in a 30-tile radius and is exhausted after a single unit of production — see this as a curiosity / test building rather than a regular industrial mine.

buildings:mining:fodlargemine.name: Large Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves → Large Mine
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves → Large Mine
buildings:mining:fodlargemine.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves large mine where Miners extract Iron Ore, Coal, Stone, and Magic Crystals. Production is unlimited.

buildings:mining:fodminer.name: Miner
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves → Deco → Miner
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves → Deco → Miner
Mines → Miner (Forge Of Dwarves)
buildings:mining:fodminer.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves decorative mine entrance. Workers are assigned but no resources are extracted; for aesthetic use only.

buildings:mining:fodsmallmine.name: Small Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves → Small Mine
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves → Small Mine
buildings:mining:fodsmallmine.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves small mine where Miners extract Iron Ore, Coal, and Magic Crystals. Maximum production of 2000.

buildings:mining:fodsmallquarry.name: Small Quarry
where: Themed Sets → Forge of Dwarves → Small Quarry
KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge of Dwarves → Small Quarry
buildings:mining:fodsmallquarry.desc: A small stone quarry from the Forge of Dwarves mod. Unlimited production.

buildings:mining:fodwlargemine.name: Large Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Large Mine
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Large Mine
buildings:mining:fodwlargemine.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves (Winter) large mine where Miners extract Iron Ore, Coal, Stone, and Magic Crystals. Production is unlimited.

buildings:mining:fodwminer.name: Miner
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Deco → Miner
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Deco → Miner
Mines → Miner (Forge Of Dwarves - Winter)
buildings:mining:fodwminer.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves Winter decorative mine entrance. Workers are assigned but no resources are extracted; for aesthetic use only.

buildings:mining:fodwsmallmine.name: Small Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Small Mine
Themed Sets → Forge Of Dwarves - Winter → Small Mine
buildings:mining:fodwsmallmine.desc: A Forge Of Dwarves (Winter) small mine where Miners extract Iron Ore, Coal, and Magic Crystals. Maximum production of 2000.

buildings:mining:fodwsmallquarry.name: Small Quarry
where: Themed Sets → Forge of Dwarves - Winter → Small Quarry
KID Mods → Themed Mods → Forge of Dwarves - Winter → Small Quarry
buildings:mining:fodwsmallquarry.desc: A small stone quarry from the Forge of Dwarves - Winter mod. Unlimited production.

buildings:mining:gtclosedmine.name: Closed Mine
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Ghost Town → Old Versions → Closed Mine
Themed Sets → Ghost Town → Old Versions → Closed Mine
Mines → Closed Mine (Ghost Town)
buildings:mining:gtclosedmine.desc: The Ghost Town Closed Mine is a placeable decoration that serves as the starting point for the Ghost Town mine upgrade chain. It has no function of its own but can be upgraded to an Old Mine or New Mine.

buildings:mining:gtnewmine.name: New Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Ghost Town → New Mine
Themed Sets → Ghost Town → New Mine
buildings:mining:gtnewmine.desc: A Ghost Town mine where workers extract stone and gold. This is a limited mine that eventually runs dry. The player selects the desired resource.

buildings:mining:gtoldmine.name: Old Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Ghost Town → Old Mine
Themed Sets → Ghost Town → Old Mine
buildings:mining:gtoldmine.desc: A Ghost Town mine already present in the landscape, where miners dig out stone and occasional gold. This is a limited mine that eventually runs dry. Can be upgraded to a New Mine.

buildings:mining:icecavemine.name: Ice Cave Mine
where: Themed Sets → Ice Castle → Ice Cave Mine
KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Ice Castle → Ice Cave Mine
Mines -> Ice Cave Mine
buildings:mining:icecavemine.desc: A mine carved into the ice from Kid's Ice Castle winter set. Miners work the cave to extract stone, iron and coal from the surrounding area.

buildings:mining:ironmine.name: Iron Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Iron Mine
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Iron Mine
buildings:mining:ironmine.desc: The Iron Mine is the Colonial Charter version of the vanilla mine. Miners can choose to produce Iron Ore, Coal, or smelt Iron directly using Furnace Fuel. When depleted, it can be upgraded to a Dark Mine to continue extraction.

buildings:mining:ironminedeep.name: Dark Mine
where: Upgrade from the Iron Mine.
buildings:mining:ironminedeep.desc: The Dark Mine is a deep upgrade of the Iron Mine, allowing continued resource extraction after the original mine nears depletion. Miners can choose to produce Iron Ore, Coal, or smelt Iron directly using Furnace Fuel.

buildings:mining:ironminedeeper.name: Deep Mine
where: Upgrade from the Dark Mine.
buildings:mining:ironminedeeper.desc: The Deep Mine is the final upgrade in the Colonial Iron Mine chain. It offers unlimited production capacity, allowing the mine to keep extracting resources indefinitely. Miners can produce Iron Ore, Coal, or smelt Iron using Furnace Fuel.

buildings:mining:ironmineimproved.name: Mine (Improved)
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Mine (Improved)
Community Toolbar → Additional Modders Toolbar → Resource → Mine (Improved)
buildings:mining:ironmineimproved.desc: The Mine (Improved) is a compact modded variant of the vanilla Iron Mine. Miners can choose to produce Iron or Coal directly. Unlike standard iron mines, this building produces refined Iron rather than Iron Ore.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew.name: Mine (Renew)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (EC Edition).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew.desc: The Mine (Renew) is the first renewal upgrade of the Editor's Choice Iron Mine, extending the life of a depleted mine. Miners can choose to produce Iron Ore or Coal. It can be further upgraded to continue extraction at higher capacities.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew2.name: Mine (Renew 2)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew2.desc: The Mine (Renew 2) is the second renewal upgrade in the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It increases the production cap to 10,000 and can be upgraded further.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew3.name: Mine (Renew 3)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew 2).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew3.desc: The Mine (Renew 3) is the third renewal upgrade in the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It increases the production cap to 11,000 and can be upgraded further.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew4.name: Mine (Renew 4)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew 3).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew4.desc: The Mine (Renew 4) is the fourth renewal upgrade in the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It increases the production cap to 12,000 and can be upgraded further.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew5.name: Mine (Renew 5)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew 4).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew5.desc: The Mine (Renew 5) is the fifth renewal upgrade in the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It increases the production cap to 13,000 and can be upgraded further.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew6.name: Mine (Renew 6)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew 5).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew6.desc: The Mine (Renew 6) is the sixth renewal upgrade in the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It increases the production cap to 14,000 and can be upgraded to the final tier.

buildings:mining:ironminerenew7.name: Mine (Renew 7)
where: Upgrade from the Mine (Renew 6).
buildings:mining:ironminerenew7.desc: The Mine (Renew 7) is the final renewal tier of the Editor's Choice Iron Mine chain. It caps at 20,000 production and has no further upgrades. The upgrade cost increases to 64 Candles at this final tier.

buildings:mining:ironsandmine.name: Iron Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Iron Sand Mine
A8 Toolbar → A8 Natural Resources → Iron Sand Mine
buildings:mining:ironsandmine.desc: The Iron Sand Mine is an A8 Japanese mod building where miners extract Iron from a rocky outcrop.

buildings:mining:jadequarry.name: Jade Quarry
where: CC Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Jade Quarry
Resource Production → Other Mines → Jade Quarry
buildings:mining:jadequarry.desc: The Jade Quarry excavates Jade from the ground. Jade is a valuable trade commodity. When depleted, the quarry can be upgraded to continue extraction.

buildings:mining:jadequarry2.name: Jade Quarry 2
where: Upgrade from the Jade Quarry.
buildings:mining:jadequarry2.desc: The Jade Quarry 2 is an upgraded Jade Quarry with a faster work cycle. It maintains the same 1000-unit cap but completes each cycle more quickly. When depleted, it can be upgraded to the final tier for unlimited production.

buildings:mining:jadequarry3.name: Jade Quarry 3
where: Upgrade from the Jade Quarry 2.
buildings:mining:jadequarry3.desc: The Jade Quarry 3 is the final tier of the Jade Quarry chain. It has no production cap, allowing indefinite Jade extraction.

buildings:mining:jinxiebittymine.name: Mine
where: Jinxie's Mods → Jinxie's Resource Production → Jinxie's Bitty Village Set Items → Bitty Mine Shaft
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Bitty Mine Shaft
buildings:mining:jinxiebittymine.desc: The Bitty Mine Shaft is a Jinxie's Bitty Village Set building where miners extract iron, coal, and stone. The mine has a limited total yield of 800 units.

buildings:mining:marblequarry.name: Marble Quarry
where: CC Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Marble Quarry
Resource Production → Other Mines → Marble Quarry
buildings:mining:marblequarry.desc: The Marble Quarry excavates Marble from the ground. Marble is a valuable trade commodity. When depleted, the quarry can be upgraded to continue extraction.

buildings:mining:marblequarry2.name: Marble Quarry 2
where: Upgrade from the Marble Quarry.
buildings:mining:marblequarry2.desc: The Marble Quarry 2 is an upgraded Marble Quarry with a faster work cycle. It maintains the same 1000-unit cap but completes each cycle more quickly. When depleted, it can be upgraded to the final tier for unlimited production.

buildings:mining:marblequarry3.name: Marble Quarry 3
where: Upgrade from the Marble Quarry 2.
buildings:mining:marblequarry3.desc: The Marble Quarry 3 is the final tier of the Marble Quarry chain. It has no production cap, allowing indefinite Marble extraction.

buildings:mining:mfiron.name: Iron Deposit
buildings:mining:mfiron.desc: The Iron Deposit is a small resource extraction building from the Mexican Fantasy mod in the Banished MegaMod. A Worker harvests raw Iron directly from the deposit until it is depleted.

buildings:mining:mfiron_copy.name: Iron Deposit (Copy)
buildings:mining:mfiron_copy.desc: The Iron Deposit (Copy) is a variant of the Iron Deposit from the Mexican Fantasy mod with a doubled maximum production of 20. This building has no toolbar registration and cannot be placed from the build menu in the current mod version.

buildings:mining:minimine.name: Mini Mine
where: Colonial Charter Toolbar → Mini → Mini Mine
Mines → Mini Mine
buildings:mining:minimine.desc: A compact Mini mine where a Miner extracts Iron Ore and Coal from a limited deposit of 500 units. Emits a Detraction happiness penalty in a 10-tile radius.

buildings:mining:newmedievalsaltmine.name: Salt Mine
where: RK Toolbar → New Medieval Town → New Medieval Commercial → Medieval Salt Mine
Themed Sets → New Medieval Town → New Medieval Commercial → Medieval Salt Mine
buildings:mining:newmedievalsaltmine.desc: A Medieval Salt Mine where miners extract salt from underground deposits. It has a limited total yield of 10000 units and produces a negative happiness effect on nearby citizens. Salt is stored in the Coal/Fuel storage category.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarry.name: Iron Quarry
where: RK Toolbar → RK transport → Iron Quarry
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Iron Quarry
buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarry.desc: The Iron Quarry is a large mine from the RK Editor's Choice Edition that extracts Iron Ore and Copper Ore. It can be upgraded through five tiers for greater production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl2.name: Iron Quarry Lvl2
where: Upgrade from the Iron Quarry.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl2.desc: The Iron Quarry Lvl2 is an upgraded Iron Quarry with increased production capacity. It can be further upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl3.name: Iron Quarry Lvl3
where: Upgrade from the Iron Quarry Lvl2.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl3.desc: The Iron Quarry Lvl3 is an upgraded Iron Quarry with further increased production capacity. It can be upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl4.name: Iron Quarry Lvl4
where: Upgrade from the Iron Quarry Lvl3.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl4.desc: The Iron Quarry Lvl4 is an upgraded Iron Quarry with high production capacity. It can be upgraded to the final tier for maximum output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl5.name: Iron Quarry Lvl5
where: Upgrade from the Iron Quarry Lvl4.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcironquarrylvl5.desc: The Iron Quarry Lvl5 is the final tier of the Iron Quarry chain, offering the highest production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarry.name: Random Quarry
where: RK Toolbar → RK transport → Random Quarry
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Random Quarry
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarry.desc: The Random Quarry is a large mine from the RK Editor's Choice Edition that produces a random mineral resource each cycle. It can be upgraded through five tiers for greater production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl2.name: Random Quarry Lvl2
where: Upgrade from the Random Quarry.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl2.desc: The Random Quarry Lvl2 is an upgraded Random Quarry with increased production capacity. It can be further upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl3.name: Random Quarry Lvl3
where: Upgrade from the Random Quarry Lvl2.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl3.desc: The Random Quarry Lvl3 is an upgraded Random Quarry with further increased production capacity. It can be upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl4.name: Random Quarry Lvl4
where: Upgrade from the Random Quarry Lvl3.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl4.desc: The Random Quarry Lvl4 is an upgraded Random Quarry with high production capacity. It can be upgraded to the final tier for maximum output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl5.name: Random Quarry Lvl5
where: Upgrade from the Random Quarry Lvl4.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrandomquarrylvl5.desc: The Random Quarry Lvl5 is the final tier of the Random Quarry chain, offering the highest production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarry.name: Rock Quarry
where: RK Toolbar → RK transport → Rock Quarry
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Rock Quarry
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarry.desc: The Rock Quarry is a large mine from the RK Editor's Choice Edition that produces Stone, Coal, and Salt. It can be upgraded through five tiers for greater production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl2.name: Rock Quarry Lvl2
where: Upgrade from the Rock Quarry.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl2.desc: The Rock Quarry Lvl2 is an upgraded Rock Quarry with increased production capacity. It can be further upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl3.name: Rock Quarry Lvl3
where: Upgrade from the Rock Quarry Lvl2.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl3.desc: The Rock Quarry Lvl3 is an upgraded Rock Quarry with further increased production capacity. It can be upgraded to continue expanding output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl4.name: Rock Quarry Lvl4
where: Upgrade from the Rock Quarry Lvl3.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl4.desc: The Rock Quarry Lvl4 is an upgraded Rock Quarry with high production capacity. It can be upgraded to the final tier for maximum output.

buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl5.name: Rock Quarry Lvl5
where: Upgrade from the Rock Quarry Lvl4.
buildings:mining:nmt30mcrockquarrylvl5.desc: The Rock Quarry Lvl5 is the final tier of the Rock Quarry chain, offering the highest production capacity.

buildings:mining:nmt30saltmine.name: Salt Mine
where: Resource Production → Other Mines → Salt Mine
RK Toolbar → RK transport → Salt Mine
buildings:mining:nmt30saltmine.desc: A Salt Mine extracts salt from the ground. It has a limited total yield of 4000 units and produces a negative happiness effect on nearby citizens. Salt is stored in the Coal/Fuel storage category.

buildings:mining:nmtwaterminedock.name: WaterMine Dock (NMT)
where: Life on the Water → NMT Docks Toolbar → NMT Dock Resources Toolbar → WaterMine Dock
RK Toolbar → NMT Docks Toolbar → NMT Dock Resources Toolbar → WaterMine Dock
buildings:mining:nmtwaterminedock.desc: An NMT Docks water mine. Miners dive to the sea floor each work cycle to extract a random mix of ores, stone, and precious minerals. No inputs required.

buildings:mining:oldhovelmine.name: Old Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Old Hovels → Old Mine
Themed Sets → Old Hovels → Old Mine
buildings:mining:oldhovelmine.desc: An Old Hovels mine where workers extract iron, stone, or coal. Can be upgraded to a mushroom mine. Select which resource to mine using the building interface.

buildings:mining:oldhovelmine2.name: Old Mine 2
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Old Hovels → Old Mine 2
Themed Sets → Old Hovels → Old Mine 2
buildings:mining:oldhovelmine2.desc: An Old Hovels mushroom mine, upgraded from the Old Mine. Workers harvest mushrooms from the cavern.

buildings:mining:ootwcrystalworks.name: Crystal Works
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Out Of This World → Crystal Works
Themed Sets → Out Of This World → Crystal Works
Refined Resources → Construction → Glass Makers → Crystal Works
buildings:mining:ootwcrystalworks.mod: Out of This World Houses v2.0
buildings:mining:ootwcrystalworks.desc: An Out Of This World Crystal Works where workers extract glass crystals from the earth.

buildings:mining:ootwmudworks.name: Mud Works
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Out Of This World → Mud Works
buildings:mining:ootwmudworks.mod: Out of This World Houses v2.0
buildings:mining:ootwmudworks.desc: An Out Of This World Mud Works where workers extract glass crystals from the earth using primitive methods.

buildings:mining:otpshipwreck.name: Shipwreck
where: Theme → Old Town Ports → Shipwreck
KID Mods → Themed Mods → Old Town Ports → Shipwreck
buildings:mining:otpshipwreck.desc: An Old Town Ports wrecked ship placed on land or water. Workers salvage wood, firewood, iron, and rum barrels from the wreck. Free to place with no build cost.

buildings:mining:placermine.name: Placer Mine
where: Other Mines → Placer Mine
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Placer Mine
buildings:mining:placermine.desc: The Placer Mine is a Colonial Charter mine that pans and sifts sediment for precious metals and gems. A miner works the site to produce Silver, Gold, or Gems randomly with each work cycle. The mine has no depletion limit and can produce indefinitely.

buildings:mining:pmine.name: Portable Mine
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Portable Mine
KID Mods → Resource Production → Portable Mine
buildings:mining:pmine.desc: A portable mine that extracts Iron or Coal. Endless and removable. Select which resource to mine using the building interface.

buildings:mining:pminerkec.name: Portable RKEC Mine
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Portable RKEC Mine
Resource Production → Other Mines → Portable RKEC Mine
buildings:mining:pminerkec.desc: The Portable RKEC Mine is a compact mine from the KID toolbar that extracts Coal, Iron Ore, and Copper Ore. Unlike most mines it has no production cap, allowing indefinite extraction.

buildings:mining:preciousmine.name: Precious Mine
where: Other Mines → Precious Mine
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Precious Mine
buildings:mining:preciousmine.desc: The Precious Mine is a Colonial Charter mine that extracts Silver, Gold, and Gems from rich ore deposits. Miners produce one of the three materials randomly each cycle. The mine has a limited total yield of 1000 units and creates a happiness detraction for nearby citizens. It can be upgraded twice t

buildings:mining:preciousmine2.name: Precious Mine (Upgrade 2)
where: Upgrade only — not available in the toolbar. Build by upgrading a Precious Mine.
buildings:mining:preciousmine2.desc: The Precious Mine (Upgrade 2) is the second tier of the Colonial Charter Precious Mine. It shares the same production stats as the base tier, producing Silver, Gold, and Gems randomly. This upgrade uses Candles to extend and improve the mine shafts.

buildings:mining:preciousmine3.name: Precious Mine (Upgrade 3)
where: Upgrade only — not available in the toolbar. Build by upgrading a Precious Mine (Upgrade 2).
buildings:mining:preciousmine3.desc: The Precious Mine (Upgrade 3) is the final tier of the Colonial Charter Precious Mine. It shares the same production stats as earlier tiers, producing Silver, Gold, and Gems randomly. This upgrade uses Lamp Oil to light the deepest mine shafts.

buildings:mining:quarry.name: Quarry
where: The Quarry is found in the vanilla Banished Mines building category.
buildings:mining:quarry.desc: The Quarry is the vanilla Banished quarry. The MegaMod reduces max production to 1,100 (from vanilla's 2,000) and adds upgrade paths when depleted: it can be upgraded into the Deep Quarry chain for increased Stone output, or the Quarry (Renew) chain for extended production.

buildings:mining:quarrydeep.name: Deep Quarry
where: Upgrade from the Quarry.
buildings:mining:quarrydeep.desc: The Deep Quarry is an upgraded Quarry that digs deeper for more Stone. When depleted it can be upgraded to the Deeper Quarry for unlimited production.

buildings:mining:quarrydeeper.name: Deeper Quarry
where: Upgrade from the Deep Quarry.
buildings:mining:quarrydeeper.desc: The Deeper Quarry is the final tier of the Quarry upgrade chain, digging to unlimited depths for Stone and Salt. It has no production cap.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew.name: Quarry (Renew)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry.
buildings:mining:quarryrenew.desc: The Quarry (Renew) is an upgrade of the base Quarry that restores it to production with an increased output cap of 3000. It can be upgraded further along the Renew chain for higher capacities.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew2.name: Quarry (Renew 2)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew2.desc: The Quarry (Renew 2) is the second tier of the Quarry Renew chain, extending the production cap to 4000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew3.name: Quarry (Renew 3)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew 2).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew3.desc: The Quarry (Renew 3) is the third tier of the Quarry Renew chain, extending the production cap to 6000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew4.name: Quarry (Renew 4)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew 3).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew4.desc: The Quarry (Renew 4) is the fourth tier of the Quarry Renew chain, extending the production cap to 8000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew5.name: Quarry (Renew 5)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew 4).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew5.desc: The Quarry (Renew 5) is the fifth tier of the Quarry Renew chain, extending the production cap to 10000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew6.name: Quarry (Renew 6)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew 5).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew6.desc: The Quarry (Renew 6) is the sixth tier of the Quarry Renew chain, extending the production cap to 20000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarryrenew7.name: Quarry (Renew 7)
where: Upgrade from the Quarry (Renew 6).
buildings:mining:quarryrenew7.desc: The Quarry (Renew 7) is the final tier of the Quarry Renew chain, with a production cap of 30000 Stone.

buildings:mining:quarrysmall.name: Small Quarry
where: CC Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Small Quarry
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Ores and Minerals → Small Quarry
buildings:mining:quarrysmall.desc: The Small Quarry is a compact quarry that fits in tighter spaces than the standard Quarry. When depleted it can be upgraded to the Deep Small Quarry chain for increased Stone output.

buildings:mining:quarrysmalldeep.name: Deep Small Quarry
where: Upgrade from the Small Quarry.
buildings:mining:quarrysmalldeep.desc: The Deep Small Quarry is an upgraded Small Quarry that digs deeper for more Stone. When depleted it can be upgraded to the Deeper Small Quarry for unlimited production.

buildings:mining:quarrysmalldeeper.name: Deeper Small Quarry
where: Upgrade from the Deep Small Quarry.
buildings:mining:quarrysmalldeeper.desc: The Deeper Small Quarry is the final tier of the Small Quarry upgrade chain, digging to unlimited depths for Stone and Salt. It has no production cap.

buildings:mining:saltworks.name: Saltworks
where: Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for other Production → Saltworks
Community Toolbar → Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Saltworks
buildings:mining:saltworks.desc: A saltworks for manufacturing salt from seawater using a wind pump and a large boiling pan.

buildings:mining:sbbarquewreck.name: Barque Wreck
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Some Boats → Barque Wreck
buildings:mining:sbbarquewreck.desc: A KID Some Boats wrecked barque placed on land or water. A Worker salvages tools, firewood, leather coats, and herbs from the wreck. Free to place with no build cost. Production capped at 2,000 units total.

buildings:mining:sbmotorizedwreck.name: Cargo Wreck
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Some Boats → Cargo Wreck
buildings:mining:sbmotorizedwreck.desc: A KID Some Boats wrecked motorized cargo boat placed on land or water. A Worker salvages coal, firewood, stone, wood, and iron from the wreck. Free to place with no build cost. Production capped at 2,400 units total.

buildings:mining:temine.name: Mine
where: KID Mods → Themed Mods → Tool Emporium → Mine
Themed Sets → Tool Emporium → Mine
Mines → Mine
buildings:mining:temine.desc: The Mine is a finite Tool Emporium mine where miners extract iron ore or coal. It produces a maximum of 3,200 units before depletion and causes unhappiness in its radius.

buildings:mining:tinmine.name: Tin Ore Mine Shaft
where: Community Toolbar → Colonial Charter Toolbar → Resource Production → Ores and Minerals → Tin Ore Mine Shaft
Resource Production → Other Mines → Tin Mine
buildings:mining:tinmine.desc: A Colonial Charter finite shaft mine for extracting Tin Ore. Miners can also directly smelt Tin by consuming Furnace Fuel. When depleted, the mine can be upgraded to the Dark Tin Ore Mine Shaft to continue extraction.

buildings:mining:tinminedeep.name: Dark Tin Ore Mine Shaft
where: Upgrade from the Tinmine.
buildings:mining:tinminedeep.desc: The Dark Tin Ore Mine Shaft is an upgraded Tinmine that extracts Tin Ore deeper underground. It can also smelt Tin directly by consuming Furnace Fuel. When depleted it can be upgraded to the Deep Tin Ore Mine Shaft for unlimited production.

buildings:mining:tinminedeeper.name: Deep Tin Ore Mine Shaft
where: Upgrade from the Dark Tin Ore Mine Shaft.
buildings:mining:tinminedeeper.desc: The Deep Tin Ore Mine Shaft is the final tier of the Tinmine upgrade chain, extracting Tin Ore with no production cap. It can also smelt Tin directly by consuming Furnace Fuel.

buildings:mining:tinyclaypit.name: Tiny Clay Pit
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Tiny Builders → Tiny Clay Pit
Resource Production → Sand & Clay → Tiny Clay Pit
buildings:mining:tinyclaypit.desc: The Tiny Clay Pit is a small quarry from the KID Toolbar that extracts Clay in a minimal footprint of only 5×6 tiles.

buildings:mining:tinymine.name: Tiny Mine
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Tiny Mine
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Tiny Mine
buildings:mining:tinymine.desc: A compact mine from the KID Toolbar where Miners extract Iron Ore and Coal in a narrow 3×9 footprint. Production is capped at 1200 units.

buildings:mining:tinyquarry.name: Tiny Quarry
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Tiny Resource → Tiny Quarry
Resource Production → Mines/Quarries for Iron/Stone/Coal → Tiny Quarry
buildings:mining:tinyquarry.desc: The Tiny Quarry is a very small quarry from the KID Toolbar that extracts Stone in a minimal footprint of only 5×6 tiles.

buildings:mining:tinysandpit.name: Tiny Sand Pit
where: KID Toolbar → Resource Production → Tiny Builders → Tiny Sand Pit
Resource Production → Sand & Clay → Tiny Sand Pit
buildings:mining:tinysandpit.desc: A compact sand pit from the KID Builders Toolbar where Workers dig Sand in a 5×6 footprint using a Hoe. Production is capped at 2000 units.

buildings:more_civic:abbey.name: Abbey
where: Colonial Charter Toolbar → Town Services → Worship and Remembrance → Abbey
More Town Buildings → Abbey
buildings:more_civic:abbey.desc: The Abbey is a Colonial Charter building staffed by monks who tend gardens, producing blueberries, herbs, and ale.

buildings:more_civic:blockhouse.name: Blockhouse
where: Theme → Fort Items → Blockhouse
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Themed Sets → Fort and Palisade Structures → Blockhouse
More Town Buildings → Blockhouse
buildings:more_civic:blockhouse.desc: The Blockhouse is a CCFrontier building where a soldier garrisons a strategic point, taxing passers-by and merchants to generate income.

buildings:more_civic:capetownbar.name: Cape Town Bar
where: Refined Resources -> Brewers → Cape Town Bar
A8 Toolbar → A8 Crafts → Cape Town Bar
buildings:more_civic:capetownbar.desc: The Cape Town Bar is a South African mod building where a brewer ferments fruits and grain into ale. A worker must be present and alcohol must be stocked for the entertainment happiness effect to apply to nearby citizens.

buildings:more_civic:capetownclocktower.name: Cape Town Clocktower
where: A8 Toolbar → A8 civics → Cape Town Clocktower
More Town Buildings → Cape Town Clocktower
buildings:more_civic:capetownclocktower.desc: The Cape Town Clocktower is a civic landmark from the A8 South African Misc mod. It provides Spirit happiness to nearby citizens within a 30-tile radius and also functions as a town hall, letting you set colony resource limits.

buildings:more_civic:cmtavern.name: The Pilgrims Rest
where: Theme → Colonial Resources → The Pilgrims Rest
KID Mods → Themed Mods → Colonial Resource → The Pilgrims Rest
buildings:more_civic:cmtavern.desc: The Pilgrims Rest is a Colonial Resources tavern where a brewer ferments fruits, roots, and grain into ales and root beer. A worker must be present and alcohol must be stocked for the entertainment happiness effect to apply.

buildings:more_civic:cornertavernt1.name: Tavern
where: Refined Resources → Luxuries Production → Corner Tavern → Tavern
RK Toolbar → NMT Corner Buildings Toolbar → NMT Corner Classic Stones Toolbar → Tavern
buildings:more_civic:cornertavernt1.desc: The Tavern is an NMT Corner Buildings building where a brewer ferments various fruits, grains, and honey into ales, beers, wines, and mead. A worker must be present and alcohol must be stocked for the entertainment happiness effect to apply to nearby citizens.

where: More Town Buildings → Corner Theater → Theater
RK Toolbar → NMT Corner Buildings Toolbar → NMT Corner Classic Stones Toolbar → Theater
buildings:more_civic:cornertheatert1.desc: The Theater is an NMT Corner Buildings building where workers perform shows and distribute tickets to nearby citizens for an entertainment happiness bonus. A worker must be present and tickets must be stocked for the happiness effect to apply.
