buildings:more_civic:courthouse.name: Court House
where: More Town Buildings → Court House
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Town Services → Civic Buildings → Courthouse
Worship → Court House
buildings:more_civic:courthouse.desc: A Colonial-themed Court House staffed by a Priest, providing Safety happiness to citizens within a radius of 100 tiles and accommodating up to 350 attendees. Only one Court House may be built per settlement.

buildings:more_civic:dsalehouse.name: Ale House
where: DS mods → Markets Taverns → Ale House
Refined Resources → Luxuries Production → Ale House
buildings:more_civic:dsalehouse.desc: The Ale House is a DS Mods tavern building. A Brewer produces Ale or Strong Ale from a variety of fruits and grains. The building provides Entertainment happiness to nearby citizens, but only when it has Alcohol in stock.

buildings:more_civic:dsglobetheatre.name: Globe Theatre
where: DS mods → Services → Globe Theatre
More Town Buildings → Globe Theatre
buildings:more_civic:dsglobetheatre.desc: Globe Theatre is a DS Mods entertainment building. Performers entertain citizens across a large radius, boosting happiness throughout the settlement. Performers must be present for the happiness effect to apply. Only one Globe Theatre can be built per settlement.

buildings:more_civic:dsnewstythtower.name: New Styth Tower
where: DS mods → Castles & Towers → Styth Towers → New Styth Tower
Themed Sets → Styth Towers → New Styth Tower
More Town Buildings → New Styth Tower
buildings:more_civic:dsnewstythtower.desc: New Styth Tower is a DS Mods watchtower that grants Safety happiness over a wide radius. When staffed by Village Guards, the tower confiscates a varied supply of goods from bandits in the surrounding area — food, tools, alcohol, clothing, fuel, herbs, and precious materials — and delivers them to th

buildings:more_civic:dsstythtower.name: Styth Tower
where: DS mods → Castles & Towers → Styth Towers → Styth Tower
Themed Sets → Styth Towers → Styth Tower
More Town Buildings → Styth Tower
buildings:more_civic:dsstythtower.desc: Styth Tower is the original DS Mods watchtower — a smaller Safety-radius alternative to the New Styth Tower. Village Guards confiscate a varied supply of goods from bandits in the surrounding area and deliver them to the town's stockpiles. Only one Styth Tower can be built per map.

buildings:more_civic:forwardpost.name: Forward Post
where: Themed Sets → Fort and Palisade Structures → Forward Post
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Fort and Palisade Structures → Forward Post
Food Processing → More Food Processing → Forward Post
buildings:more_civic:forwardpost.desc: Colonial Charter military outpost that represents a foray into enemy territory. Soldiers consume Military Supplies and return with a variety of captured goods. Player selects which type of goods to acquire.

buildings:more_civic:giftshop.name: Gift Shop
where: Theme → Gift Shop
KID Mods → Resource Production → Gift Shop
buildings:more_civic:giftshop.desc: The Gift Shop is a standalone mod civic building where a Giftmaker distributes goods to citizens. It provides Entertainment happiness to nearby citizens, but only when a worker is present, goods are in stock, and Alcohol is available. The player selects which good the shop distributes.

buildings:more_civic:govhouse.name: Governor's Office
where: Theme → Colonial Resources → Governor's Office
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Town Services → Civic Buildings → Governor's Office
buildings:more_civic:govhouse.desc: The Governor's Office is a Colonial Resources mod civic building. An Official stationed here generates Silver Pfennig without consuming any inputs. The building applies a Detraction happiness penalty to citizens within its large radius.

buildings:more_civic:ikedakabukitheater.name: Ikeda Kabuki Theater
where: More Town Buildings → Ikeda Kabuki Theater
buildings:more_civic:ikedakabukitheater.desc: A traditional kabuki theater from the A8 Japanese mod. It provides Safety happiness to nearby citizens within a 40-tile radius.

buildings:more_civic:library.name: Library
where: RK Toolbar → RK Services → Library
More Town Buildings → Library
buildings:more_civic:library.desc: A library staffed by a Librarian, providing Goods happiness within a radius of 35 tiles to up to 300 attendees.

buildings:more_civic:mdoldbailiffoffice.name: Old Bailiff's Office
where: MD Toolbar → MD Services → Old Bailiff's Office
More Town Buildings → Old Bailiff's Office
buildings:more_civic:mdoldbailiffoffice.desc: An old bailiff's office staffed by a Bailiff, providing Safety happiness within a radius of 40 tiles to up to 200 citizens.

buildings:more_civic:mdoldcourthouse.name: Old Courthouse
where: MD Toolbar → MD Services → Old Courthouse
More Town Buildings → Old Courthouse
buildings:more_civic:mdoldcourthouse.desc: An old courthouse staffed by a Bailiff, providing Safety happiness within a radius of 60 tiles to up to 350 citizens. One per village.

buildings:more_civic:oldbarnpub.name: Old Barn Pub
where: RK Toolbar → RK services → Old Barn Pub
Food Processing → Prepared Meals → Old Barn Pub
buildings:more_civic:oldbarnpub.desc: An RK Editor's Choice pub where a brewer combines meat, vegetables, and alcohol into meals. Provides Entertainment happiness to nearby citizens.

buildings:more_civic:pinetavern.name: Small Pine Tavern
where: Refined Resources → Luxuries → Small Pine Tavern
buildings:more_civic:pinetavern.desc: A compact tavern from Necora's Maritimes Pine Set, providing Entertainment happiness to nearby citizens within a 15-tile radius.

buildings:more_civic:tavern.name: Tavern
where: The Tavern is found in the vanilla Banished Social building category.
Refined Resources -> Brewers → Tavern
buildings:more_civic:tavern.desc: The Tavern is a vanilla Banished social building. A Brewer serves food and drink to citizens, providing an Entertainment happiness bonus to citizens within a 30-tile radius.

buildings:more_food:candystore.name: Candy Store
where: Theme → Christmas Mod → Candy Store
Food Processing → More Food Processing → Candy Store
buildings:more_food:candystore.desc: The Candy Store is a Christmas Mod building where Santa's Elf crafts candy from sugar or honey combined with fruit or spices. It provides a happiness bonus to nearby citizens.

buildings:more_food:candystoresa.name: Candy Store (SA)
where: Food Processing → More Food Processing → Candy Store
KID Mods → Resource Production → Candy Store (SA)
buildings:more_food:candystoresa.desc: The Candy Store is a building where a worker crafts candy from sugar or honey combined with fruit. It provides a happiness bonus to nearby citizens.

buildings:more_food:nmt30malthouse.name: Malt House
where: Food Processing → More Food Processing → Malt House
RK Toolbar → RK Transport → Malt House
buildings:more_food:nmt30malthouse.desc: A Malt House malts grains for use in brewing.

buildings:more_food:nognook.name: Nog Nook
where: Theme → Christmas Mod → Nog Nook
Food Processing → More Food Processing → Nog Nook
buildings:more_food:nognook.desc: A Christmas Mod Nog Nook where Santa's Elf crafts eggnog from milk, eggs, and spices. Provides a happiness bonus to nearby citizens.

buildings:more_food:refinery.name: Refinery
where: Food Processing → More Food Processing → Refinery
Colonial Charter Toolbar → Food Production → Food Refining → Refinery
buildings:more_food:refinery.desc: Colonial Charter refinery; processes sugar cane, sugar beets, and maple sap into refined sugar and maple syrup.

buildings:nomads:chomecoming.name: Homecoming
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Colonial Houses → Homecoming
Themed Sets → Colonial Houses → Homecoming
Town Services → Nomad → Homecoming (Colonial Houses)
buildings:nomads:chomecoming.desc: A Colonial Houses nomad attractor; attracts nomad immigrants with groups of up to 12% of total population. Only one may be built per game.

buildings:nomads:choowagon4.name: Choo Choo: Passenger Wagon
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Choo Choo → Trains → Choo Choo: Passenger Wagon
Themed Sets → Choo Choo → Trains → Choo Choo: Passenger Wagon
Town Services → Nomad → Choo Choo: Passenger Wagon (Choo Choo)
buildings:nomads:choowagon4.desc: A Choo Choo mod passenger wagon that also functions as a town hall and nomad attractor, attracting nomad groups of up to 15% of total population. Three visual variants are available (randomized at placement). Provides the same resource limit and town hall management interface as the vanilla Town Hal

buildings:nomads:fairygardenmagicportal.name: Magic Portals
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Fairy Garden → Magic Portals → select variant
Themed Sets → Fairy Garden → Magic Portals → select variant
Town Services → Nomad → select variant
buildings:nomads:fairygardenmagicportal.desc: Fairy Garden ghosted magic portals that attract nomad immigrants. Each variant limits the maximum size of arriving nomad groups as a percentage of total population. Free to place with no footprint restriction. Six variants are available with different caps.

buildings:nomads:folamppost.name: Lamp Post
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Forest Outpost → Lamp Post
Themed Sets → Forest Outpost → Lamp Post
Town Services → Nomad → Lamp Post (Forest Outpost)
buildings:nomads:folamppost.desc: A Forest Outpost decorative lamp post that attracts nomad immigrants, with groups of up to 15% of total population. Free to place instantly with no build cost. Features a small fire particle effect. Can be removed later via its upgrade button.

buildings:nomads:fpscarecrownomads.name: Nomads Scarecrow
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Friendly Pumpkin → Friendly Extra → Nomads Scarecrow → select variant
Themed Sets → Friendly Pumpkin → Friendly Extra → Nomads Scarecrow → select variant
Town Services → Nomad → select variant
buildings:nomads:fpscarecrownomads.desc: Friendly Pumpkin scarecrow decorations that attract nomad immigrants. Each variant limits the maximum size of arriving nomad groups as a percentage of total population. Place near settlement borders to encourage nomads to arrive. Six variants are available with different caps.

buildings:nomads:icecastletower.name: The Light
where: Themed Sets → Ice Castle → The Light
KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Ice Castle → The Light
Nomad -> The Light (Ice Castle)
buildings:nomads:icecastletower.desc: A glowing tower from Kid's Ice Castle winter set. The Light signals to wandering nomads, attracting a group (about 12% of the current population) to seek refuge roughly once a year — the nomad-attracting counterpart to the Ice Castle town hall, which does not draw nomads.

buildings:nomads:mfhitchingpost.name: Hitching Post
where: KID Toolbar → Themed Mods → Mexican Fantasy → Hitching Post → select variant
Themed Sets → Mexican Fantasy → Hitching Post → select variant

climates.name: [CC] Very Mild
climates.notes: Low precipitation; very predictable year to year

climates.name: Mild
climates.notes: Inherits Fair temperatures; more predictable weather

climates.name: Harsh
climates.notes: Inherits Fair temperatures; high year-to-year variance

climates.name: [CC] Marine
climates.notes: Near-freezing winters; almost no tornadoes; very stable

climates.name: [CC] Tropical (No Snow)
climates.notes: No snow; very hot; rare tornadoes

climates.name: [CC] Warm Arid (No Snow – Low Rain)
climates.notes: Extremely hot summers; very little rain

climates.name: [CC] Harsh Arid (Very Hot & Cold)
climates.notes: Extreme temperature swings; rare tornadoes despite harsh name

climates.name: Temperate
climates.notes: Southern temperate feel; long warm summers; high variance

climates.name: Harsh Hot
climates.notes: Scorching summers; very high year-to-year variance

climates.name: Freezing
climates.notes: Peak summer barely exceeds freezing; almost no crop growth

climates.name: Perfect
climates.notes: Constant 80 °F; no seasons; no precipitation variance

climates.name: Siberian
climates.notes: Extreme seasonal swings; brutal winters offset by hot summers

climates.name: Desert
climates.notes: Never cold enough to freeze; low temperature variance

climates.name: More Snow
climates.notes: Never thaws; no crop growth is possible
